The Harbor Survey
      The harbor survey began in the spring, when the ice had cleared from the inner channel and 
      the pilots could take the launch out at first light. Each morning the crew measured the depth at 
      forty marked stations, wrote the readings in a bound log, and compared them with the charts 
      drawn twenty years before.
      By the middle of summer the pattern was plain. The channel had shifted toward the eastern 
      breakwater, and the shoal off the old ferry landing had grown by almost a meter. The pilots had 
      known this for years from the feel of the boats, but the survey gave them numbers they could 
      show the port council.
      The council voted in the autumn to dredge the eastern approach and to move two of the 
      channel buoys. The survey crew stayed on through the winter to check the work, and their 
      final log, bound in green cloth, is kept in the harbor ofÏce today.

Terms of Service
          1. These terms apply to every rental of equipment from the shop, whether booked in person, by telephone, or through the website. By taking 
          the equipment the renter accepts these terms in full.
          2. The renter must return the equipment by the time written on the rental slip. Equipment returned late is charged at the daily rate for each 
          day or part of a day after that time.
          3. The renter is responsible for any damage beyond ordinary wear. The shop will inspect the equipment on its return and send a written 
          estimate of any repair within five working days.
          4. A deposit is held for the length of the rental and returned in full when the equipment comes back clean, complete, and in working order. 
          Missing parts are charged at their replacement cost.
          5. The shop may refuse a rental, or end one early, when the equipment is used in a way that puts people or property at risk. In that case the 
          unused days are refunded.
          6. Bookings cancelled at least two days before the start of the rental are refunded in full. Later cancellations are charged one day at the daily 
          rate.
          7. The shop keeps the renter's name, address, and telephone number for as long as the rental lasts and for one year after, and shares them with 
          no one except as the law requires.
